title: Theresa K NDE 687
content:
I woke up out of my sleep and started chasing my cousin. The next thing I knew I heard a long buzz/bell sound then I saw myself traveling through a brick tunnel, almost as if the tunnel was traveling past me. I was not moving it seemed but the bricks around me were, I had tunnel vision so I could not see up or down on side, just part of the side and straight ahead. There was a bright light at the end of the tunnel and I could see something in between the lights, the light was blinding almost. Then I felt something saying it was not my time, go back. I was thinking to myself, what is going on? I then heard my cousin saying, 'Theresa, Theresa?' I came back while he was in the middle of saying my name. I asked him why did he put that flashlight in my eyes. He looked at me like I was crazy and kept asking was I ok, he didn't have a flashlight. He said the ambulance was on the way. I had passed out for about five minutes, he was unsure. It was enough time for him to come back from the other end of a long hall, see something was wrong, catch the elevator down five floors call the ambulance, alert the guard and come back upstairs.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt as if she was not moving, but the bricks/tunnel were moving past her; had tunnel vision (could not see up/down/side, only part of side and straight ahead).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out (unconscious) for about five minutes while chasing her cousin; ambulance was called.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard a long buzz/bell sound before seeing the tunnel; heard cousin calling her name during the return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Buzz/bell sound occurred before the tunnel; return was triggered by a sensed message ('not my time, go back') and hearing her cousin calling her name.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived the tunnel moving past her while she felt stationary; misinterpreted the bright light as her cousin shining a flashlight in her eyes upon waking.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “it was not my time, go back.”; “Theresa, Theresa?”; “why did he put that flashlight in my eyes.”
